title: Settings
subtitle: Adjust preferences without leaving your workspace
sectionGitHint: Manage multiple Git accounts; the enabled one writes to git config --global for commits, while Jinglü matches history against every account in the list
dataStorageHint: App data directory and SQLite database path (read-only)
dataClearHint: Clear local data by module (confirmation required). “Clear all” keeps registered repos and workspaces.
dataClearRestartHint: Some UI preferences fully apply after restart
dataClearAgentChatsHint: Delete all Jingling conversations and messages (including reasoning)
dataClearAgentChatsConfirm: This permanently deletes all Jingling chats. Continue?
dataClearJinglvChatsHint: Delete all Jinglü conversations and messages
dataClearJinglvChatsConfirm: This permanently deletes all Jinglü chats. Continue?
dataClearAiSecretsHint: Clear DeepSeek API keys and commit/PR/Jinglü instructions
dataClearAiSecretsConfirm: This clears saved API keys and AI instructions. Continue?
dataClearGitAccountsHint: Clear Git accounts from Settings → Git
dataClearGitAccountsConfirm: This clears all Git identity accounts. Continue?
dataClearJinglvIdentityConfirm: This clears Jinglü contact info. Continue?
dataClearUiPrefsHint: Theme, language, fonts, pane sizes, and related prefs
dataClearUiPrefsConfirm: Reset UI preferences (may need restart). Continue?
dataClearAllHint: Clear everything above; keep registered repos and workspaces
dataClearAllConfirm: This clears chats, secrets, accounts, contact info, and UI prefs permanently. Registered repos are kept. Continue?
dataBackupHint: Exports include the database, secrets, and preferences — store the file safely. Import overwrites local data.
dataImportConfirm: Import overwrites the local database (after restart), secrets, and preferences. Only import trusted backups.
dataImportRestartHint: Restart JLGit for the database to fully take effect
gitIdentityAutoSaveHint: Saved automatically once both name and email are filled
gitAccountEmpty: No Git accounts yet — add one to get started
createGitAccountDescription: Name and email are required. The new account is enabled and written to git config --global.
editGitAccountDescription: Update name or email. If this account is enabled, global git config is synced.
gitAccountRequired: Git username and email are required
gitAccountDuplicate: An account with the same name and email already exists
gitAccountNeedOneEnabled: At least one Git account must remain enabled
sshHint: Select or generate an SSH key, then copy the public key to your Git host settings
apiKeyListHint: The enabled key is used for DeepSeek requests
balanceHint: Queried with the enabled DeepSeek API key; API calls consume balance.
balanceNeedKey: Add and enable an API key first
balanceHint: Queried with the enabled DeepSeek API key; API calls consume balance.
balanceNeedKey: Add and enable an API key first
createApiKeyDescription: Name and API Key are required. The new key will be enabled automatically.
apiKeyEmpty: No API keys yet. Add one to use 鲸灵.
apiKeyRequired: Enter a name and API Key
editApiKeyDescription: Only the display name changes. The API Key is neither shown nor modified.
aiInstructionsGitHint: Only for commit messages, PRs, and other Git generation — not Jinglü
aiInstructionsJinglvHint: Only for Jinglü chat and resume drafting — not Git commit/PR instructions
commitInstructionsHint: Included in commit message generation; JLGit defaults apply when unset — edit for your team
commitInstructionsPlaceholder: JLGit defaults are used, or write your team rules…
pullRequestInstructionsHint: Used for future PR title/description generation; JLGit defaults apply when unset
pullRequestInstructionsPlaceholder: JLGit defaults are used, or write your team PR template…
jinglvInstructionsHint: Included in Jinglü system prompt; JLGit defaults apply when unset
jinglvInstructionsPlaceholder: JLGit defaults are used, or write your resume style rules…
launchAtLoginHint: Open JLGit when you log in (system registration coming soon)
launchAtLoginOnHint: Launch-at-login preference saved (system registration coming soon)
pushAfterCommitHint: New commits select “Push to remote” by default
alsoInStatusBar: Theme and language can also be toggled from the status bar
